description: 中央災害應變中心目前開設的專案及成立情形 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 消防署. 依中央災害應變中心專案開設及縣市層級成立情形 caseCode：專案代碼、 caseName：專案名稱、 eocName：災害應變中心名稱、 openTier：開設層級，內容說明如下： 1：一級開設；2：二級開設；3：三級開設、 caseStartTime：開設時間，時間格式：西元年月日時分、 disName：災害類別名稱。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 消防署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
